name: Guidance
summary: Microsoft Research library for constrained LLM generation with a Python guidance language, token healing and multi-backend support.
description: Established open-source structured-generation toolkit (not a 2026 launch). Install guidance from PyPI (0.3.1 verified 2026-11-09). Interleaves generation, prompting and control flow; supports constrained decoding patterns across supported model backends. MIT license (guidance-ai/guidance; GitHub not archived). Model-provider credentials and compute are separate from the free library. Companion llguidance offers a faster structured-output engine used by some stacks.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install guidance. Configure model backends separately.
